title: 微機電慣性感測器製程
summary: 從質量彈簧、深矽輪廓到溫漂校正：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Mass and spring and Deep-silicon profile to Temperature calibration: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: 質量彈簧 → 共振與阻尼
stages.titleEn: Mass and spring to Resonance and damping
stages.description: 把「質量彈簧」「差動梳齒」「共振與阻尼」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Mass and spring, Differential combs, Resonance and damping.

steps.title: 質量彈簧：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Mass and spring: construct and analyze
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「靜態近似需要低於機械共振的條件」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Static approximation needs operation below resonance.
steps.instruction:
用假設 m、k 畫 F=ma 與 x=ma/k 靜態關係。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設準靜態加速度計質量 m=1 µg=10⁻⁹ kg、彈簧 k=1 N/m、加速度 a=9.81 m/s²，力 F=ma=9.81 nN，位移 x=F/k=9.81 nm。加速度加倍時位移加倍，但此例忽略阻尼、共振與非線性止擋，不能外推到衝擊量程。
steps.instructionEn:
Use hypothetical mass/stiffness to draw F=ma and x=ma/k. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a quasistatic accelerometer mass m=1 µg=10⁻⁹ kg, spring constant k=1 N/m and acceleration a=9.81 m/s². F=ma=9.81 nN and x=F/k=9.81 nm. Doubling acceleration doubles displacement in this model. Damping, resonance and nonlinear stops are absent, so do not infer shock range.
steps.observation: 靜態近似需要低於機械共振的條件；動態方程還包含阻尼與慣性項。
steps.observationEn: Static approximation needs operation below resonance; Dynamics also include damping and inertia.
steps.failure: 若採用「把靜態位移式套到所有振動頻率」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Applying static displacement at every frequency", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「質量彈簧」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：靜態近似需要低於機械共振的條件。
算例驗收：驗算 9.81 nN 與 9.81 nm，確認 µg 到 kg 的轉換是 10⁻⁹。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Mass and spring diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Static approximation needs operation below resonance.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify 9.81 nN and 9.81 nm and confirm the 10⁻⁹ conversion from micrograms to kilograms.

steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Self-test may not cover the full external mechanical path.
steps.instruction: 畫靜電測試力和真實慣性力路徑，列出可及不可驗證項。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Compare electrostatic test and inertial-force paths and their coverage. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 自我測試未必涵蓋完整外部機械路徑；電子自測未必驗證外部加速度校正。
steps.observationEn: Self-test may not cover the full external mechanical path; Electronic self-test may not verify acceleration calibration.
steps.failure: 若採用「通過自測就代表所有封裝與安裝都正確」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Assuming self-test validates all mounting/package effects", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「自我測試」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：自我測試未必涵蓋完整外部機械路徑。
steps.checkEn: Submit the Self-test diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Self-test may not cover the full external mechanical path.

steps.title: 自我測試：故障判讀與驗證
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「通過自測就代表所有封裝與安裝都正確」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Assuming self-test validates all mounting/package effects.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「自我測試」成果，先指出錯誤主張「通過自測就代表所有封裝與安裝都正確」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：電子自測未必驗證外部加速度校正。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Self-test artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Assuming self-test validates all mounting/package effects". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Electronic self-test may not verify acceleration calibration. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 自我測試未必涵蓋完整外部機械路徑；電子自測未必驗證外部加速度校正。
steps.observationEn: Self-test may not cover the full external mechanical path; Electronic self-test may not verify acceleration calibration.
steps.failure: 若採用「通過自測就代表所有封裝與安裝都正確」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Assuming self-test validates all mounting/package effects", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「自我測試」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「電子自測未必驗證外部加速度校正」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Self-test, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Electronic self-test may not verify acceleration calibration" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.
